paper.title_en: An algebra of proper observables at null infinity: Dirac brackets, Memory and Goldstone probes
paper.abstract_en: We develop a rigorous evaluation of Dirac brackets for classical observables on the phase space of radiative gravitational modes at null infinity that naturally incorporates memory effects. Considering the Ashtekar-Streubel phase space, with boundary conditions in time given by vanishing {\it news} and purely electric {\it shear}, and taking into account the infinite dimensionality of the phase space, we identify the algebra of proper observables (understood as functions on phase space that can be associated with smooth symplectic flows). We show that the action of supertranslation charges generate the correct transformations on the shear. We also show that the conventional definition of the ``Goldstone mode'' adopted in the literature cannot be associated with a proper observable, but nevertheless there exists an infinite family of proper observables, which we call {\it Goldstone probes}, that are capable of measuring the Goldstone mode. We notice that there are no Goldstone probes constructed only out of the shear {\it or} the news, providing a possible explanation for why attempts to construct a (separable) Hilbert space with different memory states have failed so far. Finally, we derive formulas for distributional Dirac brackets between local shear and news, and show that they contain non-local corrections.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在零无穷处 Ashtekar-Streubel 相空间框架下严格分析狄拉克括号与恰当可观测量的代数，涉及超平移荷、记忆效应与戈德斯通探针，属于广义相对论基础方向的理论工作；摘要给出明确的方法、结果与限制，理论深度与论证严谨性信号较强，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 零无穷处恰当可观测量的代数：狄拉克括号、记忆与戈德斯通探针
decision.abstract_zh: 我们针对零无穷处辐射引力模态相空间上的经典可观测量，发展了一套严谨的狄拉克括号计算框架，该框架自然地纳入了记忆效应。我们考虑 Ashtekar-Streubel 相空间，其时间边条件由消失的{\it news}与纯电性的{\it shear}给出，并虑及相空间的无限维性，识别出恰当可观测量的代数（恰当可观测量被理解为相空间上能够与光滑辛流相关联的函数）。我们证明超平移荷的作用在 shear 上生成了正确的变换。我们还证明，文献中采用的“戈德斯通模”的传统定义无法与某个恰当可观测量相关联，但尽管如此，仍然存在一个无穷族的恰当可观测量，我们称之为{\it 戈德斯通探针}，它们能够测量该戈德斯通模。我们注意到，不存在仅由 shear {\it 或} news 构造出的戈德斯通探针，这或许为迄今为止构造（可分）希尔伯特空间以容纳不同记忆态的尝试何以失败提供了一种解释。最后，我们推导了局部 shear 与 news 之间的分布性狄拉克括号的公式，并证明它们含有非局域修正。
